test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All kites are monkeys.

All monkeys are ants

Conclusions:

(I) Some ants are kites.

(II) Some monkeys are not kites.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/524b714f1e52c47d8757c8a78b7a85bdbb1e29ba5316366259475f47c20353ac.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some ants are kites → Follow (As all kites are monkeys and all monkeys are ants. As whole kites comes in monkeys which whole comes in ants, therefore it is true.)

(II) Some monkeys are not kites → Does not follow (As all kites are monkeys. As whole kites comes in monkeys, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
